name: University of Hertfordshire

facts.text: The University of Hertfordshire is based in Hatfield, England.
facts.sourceTitle: University of Hertfordshire for Nepali Students | 2026 Guide

facts.text: Hertfordshire suits applicants interested in business, engineering, computing, health, life sciences and creative arts.
facts.sourceTitle: University of Hertfordshire for Nepali Students | 2026 Guide

facts.text: The university has a College Lane campus (home of the Ask Herts desk in the Hutton Hub) and a de Havilland campus (the 'DeHav Hub'), and its Student Immigration Team can be reached on 01707 284800.
facts.sourceTitle: Credibility interviews as part of your Student Visa application | Ask Herts

sources.title: Sponsorship interview | International | Uni of Herts
topics: Why the University attracted you more than other universities in the UK offering the same course, whether you looked at other options, and why you decided on that University
The facilities offered at the University including accommodation, the location of the University, and your travel arrangements to the University

Your future plans, whether you wish to continue studying in the UK at a higher level, return to your home country to find a job, or remain in the UK to work, and how your degree will help you gain employment
Your responsibilities as a Student Visa holder (UKCISA guidance on protecting your Student status)
English language ability sufficient to follow your chosen course and level of study
sources.notes: Direct fetch (WebFetch, curl and browser pane) returned HTTP 403 / Cloudflare JS challenge; topics recorded from the search snippet only. Snippet says a credibility interview is part of the Student visa application process to ascertain that intentions to study in the UK are genuine, and that interviewers look for fluency and signs a student has been 'coached'; advice is to speak naturally as if to a friend or family member. Snippet does not state format, length, or who conducts it.

sources.title: Credibility interviews as part of your Student Visa application | Ask Herts | University of Hertfordshire
sources.notes: Fetched via curl (200). Page dated 13 January 2026 and concerns Home Office credibility interviews for students applying for permission to remain in the UK, not the university's own pre-CAS interview: the Home Office invites you in writing, you must confirm attendance, and 'Your visa will be refused if you do not attend'. Topic list is verbatim. Links to a fuller guide (Credibility-Guide-Word.docx on herts.ac.uk) which returned 403.
